about: Published DeepSeek-V3/R1 serving measurements with configurations stated well enough to simulate. Values are copied from the source; 'derived' fields are arithmetic on stated values and say so. Nothing here was used to fit the simulator.

cases.engine: SGLang (PD disaggregation, large-scale EP, two-batch overlap)
cases.hardware: 9 nodes x 8 H100, InfiniBand (decode side of 12 nodes)
cases.config: DeepSeek-V3, decode EP72 with DP attention, batch 256 per GPU, KV length 2000, no MTP
cases.stated: 22,282 output tokens/s per node (profile table, SGLang default)

cases.config: DeepSeek-V3, prefill EP32 with DP attention, 16,384 tokens per GPU as 4 prompts of 4,096
cases.stated: 59,337 input tokens/s per node with simulated perfect EPLB; 50,302 with the default expert distribution
cases.derived: 59,337 / 8. The simulator routes tokens uniformly, which is what 'simulated perfect EPLB' approximates; the default-EPLB figure (6,287.75 per GPU) is kept as a second reference.

cases.config: DeepSeek-V3/R1, BF16 attention + FP8 MoE, decode EP48, batch 1408 per GPU at 2k ISL, no MTP
cases.stated: 18,471 input and 9,087 output tokens per second (per GPU) for BF16 attention + FP8 MoE
cases.derived: as stated; KV length taken as 2,048 (output length not stated)

cases.engine: TensorRT-LLM (in-flight batching, attention DP, CUDA graphs)
cases.config: nvidia/DeepSeek-R1-FP4, TP8 EP8 attention DP, max_batch 384 per rank, concurrency 3072, ISL 1K OSL 2K synthetic, no MTP
cases.metric: output tok/s per GPU (end to end: prefill runs in the same iterations)

cases.engine: TensorRT-LLM (in-flight batching, attention DP, CUDA graphs)
cases.config: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 (FP8 per the page's Hopper recommendation; not stated for the row), TP8 EP8 attention DP, max_batch 128, concurrency 1024, ISL 1K OSL 2K, no MTP
cases.metric: output tok/s per GPU (end to end)

cases.hardware: 18-node H800 decode units (8 GPUs per node)
cases.config: Decode EP144 with DP attention, FP8 GEMMs and dispatch, BF16 MLA and combine, average KV length 4,989; batch per GPU not stated
cases.stated: ~14.8k tokens/s output per H800 node; average output speed 20-22 tokens/s per user
cases.derived: 14,800 / 8. Batch per GPU ~88 = 14,800 / 8 / 21 tok/s per user. A 24 h production average with unknown MTP use and load, so it is context, not a scored holdout.
